description:
Close-out of the epic. Everything stated must be a present-tense fact grounded in the code as landed.

Done when:
- .agent/docs: the scheduler doc describes the send path (match on sender, gift, in-queue, graft, lock scope), the heap doc describes gift segments and the adopted list and the accounting rules, pattern-matching.md carries the identity-pinning rule, runtime-telemetry.md lists fz.runtime.send.probe and the GC event's adopted fields with their jsonl fields. .agent/docs.md index updated.
- Guides/README: any user-facing description of message passing or process memory is checked and updated; a short section explains that messages are copied once, by the sender, into memory the receiver adopts.
- Tickets fz-sc8.9 and fz-sc8.24 (guard purity) have their descriptions updated to state that gift-heap send depends on guard purity (a guard a sender runs must not fault, allocate without bound or observe the running process).
- The PR description (ELI5 style: why, what changed, how it works, with the worked example) is written from the diff against the branch root.
- Full gate green. Commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer.
title: Agent docs, guides and dependent tickets describe gift-heap send
